Owner-only batch transfer; computes total=_value*_tos.length and loops updating balances.
Internal pure function computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Modifier restricting callers to owner or computed UNI pair address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance ownership and balance updates.
